nl: Run tools/job.py once for each of the names alpha, beta, gamma, all at the same time in the background. When all have finished, write their output lines sorted to summary-1.txt. Leave no other files behind.

entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

time.sleep(0.3)
print(f"{sys.argv[1]} done")

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "alpha"] background: true label: "alpha"
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "beta"] background: true label: "beta"
run ["python3", "tools/job.py", "gamma"] background: true label: "gamma"
jobs wait: 60s |> select stdout |> sort text |> write "summary-1.txt"
reference_bash:
mkdir -p out
python3 tools/job.py alpha > out/alpha.txt &
python3 tools/job.py beta > out/beta.txt &
python3 tools/job.py gamma > out/gamma.txt &
wait
sort out/*.txt > summary-1.txt
rm -r out
